description: Taps, app opens, installs, conversions and revenue for the workspace (or one link) over a date range, optionally grouped by day, channel (whatsapp, instagram, gmail, direct…), link, platform, campaign (the link's), country (2-letter) or the tap's UTM tags (utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_term, utm_content). Country and UTM rows cover taps since 5 Nov 2026; older taps have key null. app_version / sdk_version split app opens and installs by the app's and the Strait SDK's version they reported (accepted since 5 Nov 2026 from SDKs that send it); taps, conversions and opens that sent none are key null. Use it for "which app version broke?". Same definitions as the dashboard; days are UTC; at most 92 days per call (default: the last 30 days).

from.description: Inclusive start: 2026-09-01, an ISO date-time or epoch ms

to.description: Exclusive end, same formats; default now
